original_aarti_and_ashtak.description: Authentic Original Aarti (Jay Sadguru Swami), Mahamantra Dhun, Radhika-Krishna Ashtak, Nirvikalp Uttam Ati, Dandvat Shloks, and 5 Mandir Aartis.

premanand_swami_kirtans.author: Sadguru Premanand Swami (સદ્‍ગુરુ પ્રેમાનંદ સ્વામી / પ્રેમસખી)

brahmanand_swami_kirtans.author: Sadguru Brahmanand Swami (સદ્‍ગુરુ બ્રહ્માનંદ સ્વામી / બ્રહ્મમુનિ)

other_paramhansas_kirtans.description: Compositions of Krushnanand Swami, Bhoomanand Swami, Manjukeshanand Swami, Dayanand Swami, Akhandanand Muni, Jeram Brahmachari, Shatanand Muni, Sukhanand Swami, Nityanand Swami, etc.

acharya_parampara_kirtans.description: Compositions by Acharya Viharilalji Maharaj and Acharya Ayodhyaprasadji Maharaj.

nitya_kriya.description: Complete Full Chesta (13 padas), Shayan (Sleep) kirtans (Podhe Prabhu, Re Shyam, Podho Podho, Meetha Vahala), 8-pad Murti Dhyan Chintamani, and 12 Godi padas.
